messages:
rachel.docs: Heads-up — we're rolling a config schema tightening for SDKs next week. It will reject unknown top-level keys and require an explicit `routes` block. This can break some self-hosted config files. Migration guide: https://redwood.inference/internal/docs/config-schema-tightening :eyes:

ben.sdk: Oof, timeline? will we ship compatibility shims in the SDKs?

rachel.docs: Rollout plan: opt-in beta starts 2026-03-25, enforcement on 2026-04-01. SDKs will include a 2-release compatibility shim that logs warnings then errors. Self-hosted/custom runners must update configs if they rely on loose parsing.

ajay.eng: Quick question — which SDK releases get the shim? node + python?

rachel.docs: Node >= 4.0.0 and Python >= 3.2.0 will include the shim. Go/rust SDKs: SDK leads are adding the warning-only step for one release, then error on enforcement.

lisa.product: Will there be a feature-flag to delay enforcement for customers on Dedicated/Private tiers?

rachel.docs: Yes — `REDWOOD_CONFIG_STRICT=false` env will opt-out for a short period (until 2026-04-15 for Dedicated/Private customers who request an exception). File-level override also allowed per-instance. Please route exception requests to customers@redwood.com with subject: "Config strictness exception".

ben.sdk: Migration snippet for the docs — can we add this to the guide?

rachel.docs: Added. Example in the guide:

```
# old config (accepted before)
model: "redwood-llm-v1"
model_override: { sequence_length: 4096 }

# new canonical config (required soon)
routes: [
  { name: "default", model: "redwood-llm-v1", model_overrides: { sequence_length: 4096 } }
]
```

ajay.eng: Going to run a quick audit of infra repos for stray top-level keys. Will post results by EOD.

rachel.docs: Thanks — if you find anything nontrivial ping me directly. We'll also publish a `rake config:lint` tool in the docs repo to help.

deploy-bot: published docs: /internal/docs/config-schema-tightening — public-facing rewrite scheduled for 2026-03-23 :rocket:

lisa.product: Heads up to Growth/Support: we'll need a short customer note template and a KB article. I'll take the customer-facing copy.

rachel.docs: Awesome — adding you to the tiny ops thread. :thumbsup:

ben.sdk: One more: will the hosted API accept old loose configs for a fallback window?

rachel.docs: Hosted API will accept old configs for read-only backwards compatibility until 2026-05-01, but warnings will surface in Console and SDK logs starting 2026-03-25. After 04-01 errors may be returned for new writes unless the `REDWOOD_CONFIG_STRICT` flag is set.

ajay.eng: Cool. I'll share a short checklist for infra teams.

rachel.docs: Perfect — thanks everyone.
